message.content:
This is a molded fiber packaging production line. It is a functional unit of machines imported disassembled under one entry, so GRI 1 and Section XVI Note 4 apply. It would be classified under the heading for the machine that performs the principal function.

The candidate headings are:
- 8439: machinery for making pulp, paper or paperboard, and for finishing paper or paperboard. Subheading 8439.30 covers machinery for finishing paper or paperboard, and 8439.20 covers machinery for making paper or paperboard.
- 8441: other machinery for making up paper pulp, paper or paperboard.
- 8479: machines not specified elsewhere.

CBP rulings on molded fiber egg-tray and packaging machinery have generally gone to 8439.20 (machinery for making paper or paperboard). The 8439 heading covers machinery for making articles from pulp. Machinery for molding pulp articles is also addressed in the 8439 EN, which covers machines for making molded pulp articles such as egg boxes. I'm fairly sure of this.

Within 8439.20, the 10-digit statistical line is 8439.20.0010 or 8439.20.0090. The 8439.20.00 line is "Machinery for making paper or paperboard," so I'll use 8439.20.0090 for other machinery. Note that 8439.20.0010 may not exist, so I'm treating 0090 as the more general line.

{"hts_code": "8439.20.0090", "reason": "The disassembled but functionally unified molded fiber production line is classified under GRI 1 and Section XVI Note 4 as machinery for making paper or paperboard articles from pulp, which falls in heading 8439, subheading 8439.20."}
